calculate_elastic_tensor: run calculate_elasticity to compute the elastic tensor from an ASE Atoms object and calculator
compute_bulk_modulus: run calculate_elasticity to compute the bulk modulus VRH value for a crystal structure
compute_shear_modulus: run calculate_elasticity to compute the shear modulus VRH value for a crystal structure
calculate_elasticity_with_custom_strains: run calculate_elasticity with custom norm_strains and shear_strains sequences to control deformation magnitudes
calculate_elasticity_without_relaxation: run calculate_elasticity with relax_initial and relax_strained set to False to skip relaxation steps
